Ivy: quick follow-up on AttrV2: we've debated blobs vs columns a lot, but i want to surface a few lower-cost ideas before we lock schema.
Rohan: curious. what are you thinking?
Ivy: hybrid read-path: keep compact in-row blob for small extensions, but maintain a tiny in-memory Bloom filter (per-row prefix) in the index to cheaply answer `has_key(k)` without fetching blob. speeds up joins that only need existence.
Tess: Bloom filter sounds neat for existence checks. but false positives can cause extra blob fetches; need tunable fp rate.
Marco: for cost attribution specifically, propose a compact claim record not by trace_id full string but by a 64-bit SHA truncated digest + sequence number: claim_key = sha64(trace_id). this lets us keep claims tiny and indexable. billing does a digest-join.
Rohan: truncation collision risk? with 64-bit it's tiny for our scale but we should log collision alarms and fallback to full trace lookup if detected.
Ivy: claim TTL 10d, stored in a RocksDB-style local KV per billing shard for O(1) reads. writes are idempotent (write-if-newer). claims include source and schema_version header.
Tess: another operational win: keep a small replicated cache for claims in each billing process to avoid cross-network lookups. update via compacted changelog (kafka) and local write-through sink.
Marco: about hot keys like model_id/route: instead of auto-promote, expose a lightweight UI where product/owners can request promotion. system suggests candidates via freq metrics, but human-in-the-loop avoids noisy promotions.
Rohan: SDK migration: provide a tiny server-side translation map for 12 months and a client shim for 6 months. also emit a metric "legacy_key_hits" per-tenant so owners can track upgrade progress.
Ivy: monitoring: create dashboards for claim_latency_p99, claim_collision_count, blob_fetch_rate (post-bloom), promoted_key_growth, and billing_match_rate. alert if match_rate drops >0.5% or collision_count > 1/day.
obs-bot: created ticket ORG-11177 "AttrV2: bloom-filter blob hints + digest cost-claims" assigned to Ivy, Rohan, Tess, Marco. :white_check_mark:
Ivy: i'll draft a 1-page addendum with owners and tradeoffs, will post link here when ready.
